desc: Identify the reduction from distinct indegree sequences to the number of unrooted forests of \(G\) via graphical zonotopes.
Derive and validate a constant-state frontier connectivity DP for the total forest count, with correct handling of the rim wraparound edge.
Prove or clearly justify the graphical-zonotope theorem application for this graph and its exact equality with distinct indegree vectors.
Design an \(O(N)\), \(O(1)\)-state modular implementation and verify boundary cases including all-zero and all-one strings.
Validate the resulting recurrence against sample 1, sample 2, and small brute-force cases conceptually.
